strategy.text: (1) ATTACK? Amoonguss likely attacks or sets status. Candidates: Spore (sleep), Sludge Bomb (Poison STAB), Giga Drain (Grass STAB, OHKOs Crawdaunt), Toxic. Against Crawdaunt, Giga Drain is the killer (95-113%). Amoonguss is slow (max ~174 Spe vs my 209), so Crawdaunt would move first — but it still dies to Giga Drain. (2) SWITCH? Amoonguss is a defensive pivot; unlikely to switch, it can't predict my Hatterene tech. (3) THEIR READ: they see Crawdaunt, a Life Orb attacker that just killed Gyarados; they'll expect a strong Dark/Water hit, not a Magic Bounce switch. (4) MY OPTIONS: staying with Knock Off does 69-81% (item removed) but Crawdaunt risks death to Giga Drain (95-113%) and even Sludge Bomb leaves it at 23-33%. Switching to Hatterene (slot 4): forfeits turn, Hatterene eats the hit but survives every branch (Giga Drain 21-25%, Sludge Bomb 52-62%, Spore/Toxic bounced by Magic Bounce). GAIN: neutralizes Amoonguss's status moves and next turn Hatterene's Psyshock does 88-104% (31% OHKO, else guaranteed 2HKO) — Amoonguss can't KO Hatterene back. This is the steadier line; Crawdaunt is too valuable to trade into a likely Giga Drain. (5) MOST LIKELY: Amoonguss clicks Spore or Sludge Bomb/Giga Drain; Magic Bounce reflects Spore back, or Hatterene simply tanks the attack. Falsifier: if Amoonguss switches out, I still have Hatterene in a good matchup. (6) SEQUENCE: switch in Hatterene → Amoonguss acts (Spore bounced / attack tanked) → next turn Hatterene fires Psyshock for 88-104%.
